atAGlance: Tôm hấp nước dừa is shrimp steamed in coconut water, usually with sweet broth, herbs, and salt-pepper-lime dip.
whatItIs: Tôm hấp nước dừa is shrimp steamed in coconut water so the shellfish tastes gently sweet, clean, and fragrant.
howToEnjoy: Peel if needed, dip lightly in lime-pepper salt, and taste the coconut sweetness before adding chili.
howLocalsOrder: Order tôm hấp nước dừa as a shared shrimp plate. Ask whether shells remain and request less chili if you want the coconut sweetness to lead.
worthKnowing: This is a gentler Vietnamese seafood order than salt-chili grilling: coconut water sweetens the steam rather than turning into a creamy sauce.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
